components.css: .ds-scene-card{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);color-scheme:light;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:16px;padding:24px 26px 18px}.ds-scene-card h3{max-width:25ch;font:700 1.65rem/1.08 Barlow,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.015em}.ds-scene-card p{margin:12px 0 18px;color:var(--paper-muted);font:400 .96rem/1.5 Barlow,'Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-scene-footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;border-top:1px solid #d8cfbd;padding-top:13px}.ds-status-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;color:var(--paper-muted);font:600 .78rem/1.5 Barlow,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;white-space:nowrap}.ds-scene-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:42px;padding:9px 13px;border:1px solid var(--ink);border-radius:9px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);font:600 .9rem/1.3 Barlow,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease}.ds-scene-button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#49365e;border-color:#49365e}.ds-scene-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #63428b;outline-offset:5px}.ds-scene-button:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-scene-button:disabled{background:#e6decd;border-color:#d8cfbd;color:#736878;cursor:not-allowed}

narrative.overview:
Dub Saboteur is a playful arcade cabinet for two people passing one device. Ink-purple framing, warm cream scene cards and transcript, and flat lavender controls make game state legible without turning the full screen neon. Bungee gives the premise a marquee; Barlow keeps setup, directions, and reading straightforward.

The journey moves from a scene lobby to a private directing desk and an independent listener room, then returns to a clear reveal. Selection combines a filled state, a border, and a check. The listener receives neutral scene context, transcript, playback, and choices without the director's private objective or take details.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-purple framing around warm cream reading and scene surfaces.
Lavender marks primary actions, selected choices, sound readiness, and the reveal.
Bungee leads; Barlow carries controls and scene reading.
Flat, tactile controls use crisp borders and brief feedback.
The listener view stays neutral and private-round details stay hidden.

rules.name: The Lavender Action Rule
rules.body: Keep lavender for actions, selection, sound readiness, and the reveal; let ink-purple and warm cream carry the large surfaces.

rules.name: The Cabinet Type Rule
rules.body: Use Bungee for the wordmark and headlines; keep interface instructions and scene reading in Barlow.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with color and borders. Keep controls tactile through their pressed state, not through shadow.

dos: Do keep the selected state clear with fill, border, and a check or label.
Do use the locally bundled Bungee and Barlow faces for their established roles.
Do keep the listener surface neutral and free of private-round details.
donts: Don't add neon glows, fake waveforms, or simulated audio data.
Don't add shadows to the flat cabinet surfaces.
Don't move the director's objective, protected-line cue, direction, or take provenance into the listener room.
